description:
Job Description – Program Manager

Company: Bijliride

Location: Madhapur, Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Experience: 2–6 Years

Qualification: MBA / PGDM Preferred

About Bijliride

Bijliride is a fast\-growing electric mobility company focused on building sustainable, affordable, and convenient mobility solutions through electric two\-wheeler rentals, B2B fleet solutions, 3PL services, battery swapping, and EV mobility solutions.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Program Manager who will be responsible for building and managing structured programs across business operations, franchise expansion, and cross\-functional teams.

The role will focus on team alignment, organizational matrices, SOPs and documentation, reporting systems, franchise reporting, and execution of franchise/business expansion projects.

The ideal candidate should be highly organized, analytical, proactive, and capable of working across multiple teams to ensure programs are executed effectively and business objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Program \& Project Management

* Plan, execute, and monitor strategic business and operational programs.
* Manage end\-to\-end franchise projects, from planning and setup to execution and performance monitoring.
* Define project objectives, timelines, milestones, KPIs, and ownership.
* Track project progress and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Identify operational challenges and drive timely resolution.
* Coordinate multiple teams to ensure smooth project execution

2\. Franchise Management \& Expansion

* Support the development and execution of franchise expansion projects.
* Build structured processes for franchise onboarding, launch, operations, and performance tracking.
* Develop and maintain franchise reporting systems and dashboards.
* Track franchise\-wise KPIs, revenue, fleet performance, utilization, operational performance, and other business metrics.
* Coordinate with franchise partners and internal teams to ensure alignment.
* Identify gaps in franchise operations and drive corrective actions.
* Support new franchise launches and ensure readiness across operations, people, assets, and processes.

3\. Team Alignment \& Team Matrix

* Build and maintain team structures and responsibility matrices.
* Define roles, responsibilities, ownership, and reporting relationships across teams.
* Create RACI / team responsibility matrices wherever required.
* Ensure clear ownership of tasks and deliverables.
* Improve communication and alignment between Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, Technology, and other functions.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups to ensure teams remain aligned with program objectives.

4\. Reporting \& MIS

* Build and maintain team reporting systems and performance dashboards.
* Establish standardized reporting formats across departments.
* Track team\-wise and function\-wise KPIs.
* Prepare weekly and monthly management reports.
* Consolidate operational and business data for leadership review.
* Identify trends, gaps, and performance issues through data analysis.
* Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and actionable.

5\. SOPs, Policies \& Documentation

* Create, standardize, and maintain SOPs, process documents, checklists, and operational guidelines.
* Document workflows and ensure processes are clearly defined.
* Work with functional teams to identify process gaps and improve existing SOPs.
* Ensure teams understand and follow documented processes.
* Maintain proper documentation for new programs, projects, and franchise operations.
* Regularly review and update SOPs based on operational requirements.

6\. Process Improvement

* Identify inefficiencies across existing processes and recommend improvements.
* Develop systems and frameworks to improve operational efficiency.
* Standardize processes across teams and franchise locations.
* Monitor implementation and measure the impact of process improvements.
* Drive accountability through clear KPIs, ownership, and reporting mechanisms.

7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Act as a central point of coordination between different business functions.
* Work closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, Technology, Marketing, and leadership teams.
* Ensure dependencies between teams are identified and managed.
* Follow up on action items and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate critical issues to leadership with clear analysis and recommended solutions.

Candidate Requirements

* MBA / PGDM preferred.
* 2–6 years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, Business Operations, Management Consulting, Business Strategy, or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of project planning, execution, and tracking.
* Experience in building MIS, dashboards, reporting structures, and performance matrices.
* Strong documentation and SOP creation skills.
* Excellent Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through.
* Experience in franchise operations, business expansion, EV, mobility, logistics, or similar industries will be an advantage.

Key Skills

* Program \& Project Management
* Franchise Operations \& Expansion
* SOP \& Process Documentation
* Team Matrix \& RACI
* MIS \& Reporting
* Dashboard Management
* KPI Tracking
* Cross\-Functional Coordination
* Process Improvement
* Business Analysis
* Stakeholder Management
* Excel / Google Sheets

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work closely with the leadership team.
* Exposure to business expansion and franchise operations.
* Hands\-on experience in building systems, processes, and reporting frameworks.
* Opportunity to work in the growing EV and electric mobility industry.
* Career growth and leadership exposure.
* Fast\-paced and dynamic work environment.

Immediate joiners are preferred.

Pay: ₹300,000\.00 \- ₹700,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Madhapur, Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Current \\ Last salary
* Expected salary

Work Location: In person

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Project Coordinator** with 15–20 years of experience in the construction industry to coordinate and monitor construction projects from **project initiation through completion and final handover**.

The ideal candidate should have successfully managed/coordinated **a minimum of 5 construction projects from beginning to end**, including planning, execution, coordination, documentation, monitoring, completion, and handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the complete project lifecycle from **project initiation to final handover**.
* Coordinate with project managers, architects, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedules, milestones, budgets, and quality standards.
* Prepare and maintain project schedules, trackers, MIS reports, progress reports, and documentation.
* Coordinate project meetings and ensure timely follow\-up and closure of action points.
* Monitor drawings, approvals, BOQs, specifications, material requirements, and other project\-related documents.
* Coordinate with site teams to identify and resolve execution\-related issues.
* Track material procurement, deliveries, subcontractor activities, and site requirements.
* Liaise with consultants and contractors to ensure smooth project execution.
* Monitor project timelines and proactively highlight delays, risks, and critical issues to management.
* Assist in cost monitoring and ensure project activities are executed within the approved budget.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, snag rectification, and quality\-related activities.
* Ensure proper documentation and closure of project activities.
* Coordinate **project completion, statutory approvals, testing \& commissioning, snag clearance, documentation, and final handover**.
* Maintain complete project records, including as\-built drawings, warranties, manuals, completion certificates, and handover documents.
* Provide regular updates and MIS reports to senior management.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* **15–20 years of relevant experience** in construction/project coordination.
* Bachelor's degree in **Civil Engineering / Construction Management / Architecture** or a related field.
* Candidates with a **B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering** will be preferred.
* Must have successfully completed **at least 5 construction projects from project commencement through final handover**.
* Strong experience in coordinating multiple stakeholders across the project lifecycle.
* Good understanding of construction processes, project planning, execution, and handover procedures.
* Strong knowledge of project documentation, scheduling, and reporting.
* Experience in **MS Project / Primavera / AutoCAD / MS Excel / MS Office** will be an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong project coordination and organizational skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple activities and priorities
* Strong follow\-up and problem\-solving skills
* Good knowledge of construction practices and project controls
* Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines
* Strong reporting and documentation skills
* Leadership and team coordination abilities

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should have hands\-on experience in **end\-to\-end construction project execution**, with a proven track record of taking projects from **planning/initiation → execution → monitoring → completion → snag clearance → final handover**.

**Candidates who have completed a minimum of 5 projects end\-to\-end will be given preference.**

Pay: ₹80,000\.00 \- ₹95,000\.00 per month

title: Project Manager
description:
**Overview**  


Microsoft Industry Solutions is a global organization hosting over 7,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. Our organization is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

We take pride in embodying Microsoft's mission of empowerment, promoting a growth mindset, inspiring excellence, and fostering a culture of inclusivity where everyone is encouraged to share their unique perspectives and be their authentic selves. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to global Microsoft consulting projects. We are looking for project managers with a passion for operational excellence to drive our cloud consumption goals and maximize our customers’ digital transformation outcomes.

The PMO Project Manager will be part of the Business Excellence \- Operations organization. They will be aligned and accountable to an ISD (Industry Solutions Delivery) Area Project Manager supporting the project delivery lifecycle for the ISD engagements within the Area. The role will support the delivery management roles delivering engagements to our customers, helping maximize their customer facing time by providing direct support and coordination. The PMO Project Manager will be involved in delivery management aspects such as methodologies, tools, processes, financials, staffing, and operations towards ensuring the engagements are set up for success and flawless/agile execution. The role will also provide ongoing delivery management/operational support for multiple engagements.

Are you ready to join us and create the future? Come as you are, do what you love—start your journey with us today!  

**Responsibilities**  

Work with the Area Project Manager to deliver engagements within an assigned Area.


Responsible for endtoend project financials, drive key performance metrics, proactively manage risks and issues with financials—including recovery actions—and ensure strong quality and changes required throughout delivery


Responsible for improving process adherence, project hygiene, timely reporting, and maximizing customer satisfaction.


Validate Engagement/Project Setup/Staffing, Initiation Schedule, Issue/Risk updates from Sales to Delivery, create project structure/base financial plan.


Support resource management for the engagement.


Setup consumption tracking, initiate/confirm Subcontractor engagement setup, support recommended Security practices, Issue/Risk management, track/report status, update project forecast, record/approve time/expenses.


Initiate/complete project closure, reconcile project budget, capture lessons learned.


Support Area Project Manager on managing escalations around staffing and billing processes related to delivery.

  

**Competencies:**  

Risk \& Issue Management: Risk identification, prioritization, mitigation, and proactive issue resolution


PMO Governance \& Compliance: Ensure adherence to PMO standards, controls, and delivery frameworks


Quality Management: Project hygiene, quality assurance, and continuous improvement


Resource \& Capacity Management: Resource planning, utilization tracking, and dependency alignment


Reporting \& Analytics: Executive dashboards, KPIs, and datadriven insights


Change \& Dependency Management: Structured change control and crossproject coordination for solving any issues on project.


Leadership: Assist the Delivery Management roles effectively across the Initiation, Planning, Monitoring \& Controlling and Closure phases of a project, towards ensuring delivery is set up for success aligning with the customer expectations. Help track project financials, monitor expenses, and ensure resources are used efficiently.


Communication: Effective communication skills. Establish/conduct regular cadence with the PMO Process Lead and the Area Project Manager. Help raise issues needing attention around project hygiene, staffing, quality, risks, and issues.

  

  

  

**Qualifications**  


Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 3\+ years' experience in project management.

OR equivalent experience.  

**Business Impact** Support Area Project Manager to increase the Area Project Manager bandwidth resulting in streamlined delivery process, predictable outcomes, focus on customer issues. Escalates issues to Area Project Manager. Adheres to quality assurance standards. Leverages standard tools as directed to align with engagement hygiene standards. Learn about the products and services of Microsoft's Cloud and Support businesses and share learnings with others as appropriate.
Additional or Preferred Qualifications

Active PMP/CAPM certification Familiarity with Azure Dev Ops Exposure to LLM and agentic AI  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
